correction_note: Remove the earlier unsupported phrase network-scoped. The source says unique to the component; no network-only uniqueness scope is asserted. | UCI identifies an ISA participant and qualified virtual ID; previously corrected 'network-scoped' uniqueness is not asserted.
ISA composition is a CIC-mediated integration collection and not a compulsory physical System superclass.
ISA component/Controller are network/service roles, not one-to-one physical individual identities.
Composition member visibility controls ISA exposure; physical part-of is not entailed.
CIC-to-member interface can be ISA or native but does not specify actual cable/connector or external installation.
Observable Declaration is a named/typed Event-reporting field contract and not a performed value or stream schema.
An Event is the transmitted report, distinct from an original observing act and OMS resultTime.
CCD declares generic capabilities, not the set/current choice of operating modes.
Status carries current property values; only specialized Camera Mode supports a narrower mode meaning.
Request defines invocation with request id and parameters; no claim that a case actually issued or executed it.
Response reports ongoing/final dispositions; SUCCESS does not independently verify hardware effect.
Visible versus opaque describes CIC presentation/source attribution, not whether physical equipment exists.
Virtual ISA member UCI embeds CIC UCI + suffix; not a new physically certified probe.
Visible/taskable transparent versus visible/untaskable translucent are distinct; Figure2 Member B tasks label tension preserved.
CIC may perform, broker or relay; receiver/forwarder need not be actual equipment performer.

native_term: CCD: properties / observables / commands / custom types
correction_note: CCD separately declares properties, observables, commands and custom types; no generic operating-mode list.
Config capability readiness and reporting differ from execution and physical state.
Property Declaration mutability/range does not establish default or active operating mode.
Min/Max Status Intervals govern network reporting/heartbeat and cannot establish sensor measurement interval or health.
Event.source/time/eventID identifies a source-reported event, not actual Bennett QA/source history or original resultTime.
Event Reference corrects/augments Event; it does not trace each API digital copy to its independent original historical observation.
QUEUED and IN PROGRESS are nonfinal; SUCCESS reports final disposition but not independently measured effect.
Authorization precedes forwarding but determining authorization SUCCESS can mean authorized=No; command processing remains separate.
Controller deployment/network topology is distinct from geolocated hosting station, sensor surveyed coordinates and dated installation.
Custom/Nominated/Accepted extension status is not automatic core ISA adoption or evidence of model acceptance.
